2. A. Eligibility condition
As provided under Section 15(5) and 15(6) of the Right to Information Act, 2025 as
detailed below:
(i) The State Information Commissioner shall be persons of eminence in the public
life with wide knowledge and experience in law, science and technology, social
service, management. journalism. mass media or administration and governance
(ii) The State Information Commissioner shall not be a Member of Parliament or
Member of the Legislature of any State or Union Territory. as the case may be. or
hold any other Office of profit or connected with any political party or carrying on
any business or pursuing any profession
B. Other essential qualification

Age: Person who have attained the age of 65 years shall not be eligIble for

Terms of Office: Under section 16 (2) of the RTI Act. 2005 read with Section 12 of
the Right to Information Rules, 2019 (notified vide Ministry of Personnel, Public
Grievances & Pensions, Deptt. Of Personnel & Training No. G.S.R. 810 (E) dated
24th October, 2019):-
Every State Information Commissioner shall hold office for a term of
three years from the date on which he enters upon his office or till he attains
the age of sixty-five years, whichever is earlier,and shall not be eligible for
reappointment as such State Information Commissioner:
Provided that every State Information Commissioner shall, on vacating
his office under this sub-section. be eligible for appointment as the State
Chief Information Commissioner in the manner specified in sub-section (3) of
section 15.
ProvIded further that where the State Information Commissioner is
appointed as the State Chief Information Commissioner, his term of office
shall not be more than five years in aggregate as the State Information
Commissioner and the State Chief information Commissioner.
